title: 阿木木·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 巨大的绷带头部留着暗色眼孔，短短的四肢被层层包裹。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Amumu remains a very small childlike mummy with a large bandaged head, small dark eye openings, short limbs, and a compact fully wrapped body. Preserve the recognizable overlapping green cloth layers and a loose bandage end without changing him into an adult. Show clean intact wrapping, a thoughtful face, and no exposed remains, wounds, or frightening anatomical details.
art_direction.scene: A balanced near-frontal full character, subtle contrapposto if anatomically appropriate, silhouette opening into a large quiet paper field. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: moss green, sandstone, blue shadow, pale gold; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
